title: Cosmic Vortex Spiral
description: A swirling vortex tunnel composed of concentric rings receding into a glowing golden-orange center. The surrounding space is filled with deep blue, teal and purple bokeh particles and scattered golden specks resembling stars or fireflies.
prompt: A hypnotic swirling vortex tunnel made of concentric textured rings that spiral inward toward a bright golden-orange glowing core. Deep blue and teal cosmic space filled with soft glowing bokeh orbs and scattered luminous golden particles, surreal ethereal atmosphere, painterly style with visible brushwork and rich color blending.
